description: This Python script manages firmware header creation, patching, and CRC calculations for Nuvoton NPCX EC series firmware images, including handling bootloader headers, CRC signatures, and firmware load addresses.

classes.name: EcstArgs
classes.description: Class representing command line arguments for firmware processing.

methods.name: _bt_mode_handler
methods.description: Creates bootloader table using provided arguments, orchestrating firmware header patching and CRC calculations.

methods.name: _set_input_and_output
methods.description: Validates input file, creates output file, and returns output path.

methods.name: _check_chip
methods.description: Verifies if the specified chip name is valid.

methods.name: _set_anchor
methods.description: Writes firmware header anchor value to output file.

methods.name: _set_extended_anchor
methods.description: Writes extended header anchor based on CRC enable flag.

methods.name: _check_firmware_header_offset
methods.description: Validates firmware header offset for alignment and size constraints.

methods.name: _set_spi_flash_maximum_clock
methods.description: Sets maximum SPI clock frequency and ratio in header.

methods.name: _set_spi_flash_mode
methods.description: Configures SPI read mode and burst mode.

methods.name: _set_error_detection_configuration
methods.description: Enables or disables firmware CRC in header.

methods.name: _set_firmware_load_start_address
methods.description: Sets firmware load address and size, validating alignment and RAM boundaries.

methods.name: _set_firmware_entry_point
methods.description: Defines firmware entry point, either from argument or from firmware image, validating address range.

methods.name: _set_firmware_crc_start_and_size
methods.description: Configures CRC start address and size, ensuring 4-byte alignment and boundary constraints.

methods.name: _set_firmware_length
methods.description: Writes firmware length to header.

methods.name: _set_flash_size
methods.description: Sets flash size in header, validating against allowed values.

methods.name: _set_reserved_bytes
methods.description: Fills reserved header bytes with padding.

methods.name: _set_firmware_header_crc_signature
methods.description: Calculates and writes CRC signature for firmware header.

methods.name: _set_firmware_image_crc_signature
methods.description: Calculates and writes CRC signature for firmware image.

methods.name: _copy_image
methods.description: Copies firmware image from input to output, padding to 16 bytes, and updates firmware length.

methods.name: _merge_file_with_bt_header
methods.description: Merges bootloader header into firmware binary at specified offset.

methods.name: _create_bt_header
methods.description: Creates a bootloader table header with signature and pointer.

methods.name: _create_table
methods.description: Helper for CRC calculation, creates CRC lookup table.

methods.name: _crc_update
methods.description: Updates CRC value with new byte.

methods.name: _finalize_crc
methods.description: Finalizes CRC calculation.

methods.name: _hex_print_format
methods.description: Formats integer as hex string.

methods.name: _exit_with_failure_delete_file
methods.description: Prints error, deletes output file, and exits with failure.

methods.name: _exit_with_success
methods.description: Prints success message and exits.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, initializes and starts firmware processing.
